# Public provider-support test fixtures

Snapshots of each MIT plugin manifest, no-tool JavaScript entry and catalog. They contain no credentials. Tests may use the exact local release ZIPs instead by setting `AIDE_SUPPORTER_ZIP_DIR` to a directory containing `deepseek.zip` and `ali.zip`; packages are never committed here.

- https://github.com/skyelan1999/aide-pkg-DeepSeekSupporter/tree/932e99d24e2186a869210352e69e8a5c841c5686
- https://github.com/skyelan1999/aide-pig-ALiBaiLianSupporter/tree/2f5f5f5bd46ca5e5da1693f341ade6648feefbcd
